text: This report recommends the naming of a future parkland located at 677 Queen Street East, a matter for which Community Councils have delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending that the future parkland located at 677 Queen Street East, be officially named "Riverside Common". The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the policy criteria in the Council-approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and verifies that the proposed park name meets the criteria.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Officially named the future park located at 677 Queen Street East "Riverside Common".
